decisionLogic: A numeric ground-distance uncertainty zone is permitted only when declared by the source or measured against a higher-accuracy reference. Map scale alone remains numerically indeterminate.
exclusions: No conversion from scale denominator to an invented metre tolerance
Project display assumptions are not evidence
validationMethod: Positive, negative, boundary, missing-data and out-of-scope unit tests
reopenCondition: A source-declared ground zone or higher-accuracy comparison becomes available
